subject.title: Cron Jobs Calendar View for Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw accept a narrow 24-hour Cron Jobs timeline as the first product slice, or require the broader day/week calendar and rescheduling design before implementation?
rationale: The request is a new Control UI product capability, not a broken existing contract, and the open implementation candidate covers only part of the requested scope while needing a substantial rebase.

options.title: Accept Narrow Timeline First
options.body: Rebase or replace the linked PR against the current cron page, preserve current cron/status/i18n contracts, and track broader day/week/editing behavior separately.

options.title: Design Full Calendar Scope First
options.body: Pause the current branch and require a product design covering daily, weekly, quick stats, drag-and-drop, and validation behavior before implementation.

options.title: Decline Core Calendar View
options.body: Close the issue and linked PR after maintainers decide the current list and run-history UI is enough for core.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Timeline First
recommendation.body: Rebase or replace the linked PR against the current cron page, preserve current cron/status/i18n contracts, and track broader day/week/editing behavior separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent cron UI commits and the existing ClawSweeper discussion point to steipete as the strongest available routing signal for the product-scope decision.
